parties: Devansh Trademart LLP; Inox Wind Limited
headline: Devansh Trademart LLP files Regulation 10(5) disclosure in Inox Wind acquisition
sum: Devansh Trademart LLP has submitted a substantial acquisition disclosure to NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 10(5), signalling a material stake acquisition or triggering threshold breach in Inox Wind Limited.
implication: A Regulation 10(5) disclosure indicates the acquirer has crossed a 5% threshold (or announced an intent to acquire a controlling stake); counsel must immediately verify the exact shareholding crossover, mandatory offer obligations, and whether a full open offer is required under Regulation 18.
detail: Devansh Trademart LLP has filed a disclosure under Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the NSE on 18 August 2026. This disclosure is typically triggered when an acquirer crosses the 5% threshold or announces an acquisition that would trigger takeover code obligations. The filing does not disclose the acquisition consideration or the exact shareholding acquired in this primary source; further NSE/BSE exchange filings, SEBI archival orders, and company announcements are necessary to establish the transaction value, timing, and offer structure.
